1.title: IShowSpeed kicks off World Cup closing ceremony in blaze of colour
1.summary: Another star-studded performance at half-time will include Shakira, BTS, Madonna and Justin Bieber.

2.title: In Maine Senate Race, Jackson Sprints Ahead of Pack, as Bellows Drops Out
2.summary: Troy Jackson, a progressive, solidified his edge over his rivals in an abbreviated nominating contest to replace Graham Platner. Shenna Bellows, another candidate, bowed out.

3.title: In Arizona’s Primaries, Democrats Fight Over a House Seat They Need Badly
3.summary: Democrats have a chance to flip a competitive battleground district in and around Scottsdale, but the winner of Tuesday’s primary will emerge bloodied and broke.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Edge Closer to Wider War After U.S. Soldiers Killed
4.summary: The United States was said to be sending more warplanes to the Middle East, a move that was already in the works before Iranian fire killed two soldiers in Jordan.

5.title: Russia Batters Kyiv in One of the Largest Missile Assaults of the War
5.summary: On Saturday, Ukraine hit two warehouses in Russia in strikes that killed at least eight people and injured 62.

6.title: Russia launches major ballistic missile attack on Ukrainian cities
6.summary: Eight people die and dozens are injured as several cities are hit by missile and drone attacks, while Kyiv continues its own assault on Russian infrastructure.
